text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry so much, Trainy! I'll be back 
on my feet in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is that a mountain of carrots? There 
are heaps of veggies, meat, and fish too!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I'm completely starving...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! How could I possibly sit 
still with all these ingredients right in 
front of me?!"

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Hishi Ama-neesan! All hail 
Tracen Academy's number one master chef!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Aren't the ingredients starting to 
move...!?

text_block_list.name: Ingredients
text_block_list.text:
"Veggies, veggies, veggies... Meat, meat, 
meat... Fish, fish, fish, fish..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! The ingredients combine and 
transform into a monster?!

text_block_list.name: Ingredient Monster
text_block_list.text: FOOD STALLS?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way~. At this rate, we're the ones 
who're gonna get eaten~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, getting eaten by an Ingredient 
Monster? There's no way in hell I'm 
letting something that absurd happen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Take a taste of my hammer of justice!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama KIIICK!!

text_block_list.name: Ingredient Monster
text_block_list.text: GROCERIES?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter... Crumble...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just sit still and get cooked... That's 
your 'atone-meal' for your sins!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Hishi Ama-neesan! You made 
a pun on 'ingredients' and 'atonement'!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, eat up and enjoy the full Hishi 
Ama course! If anything's ever troubling 
you, just call on me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's roll, Hishi Ama Bike!

text_block_list.name: Hishiyama Bike
text_block_list.text: (Vroom... Vroom vroom vroom...!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I feel totally refreshed 
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having had a fun dream and a good rest, 
Hishi Amazon's fatigue had completely 
vanished.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...?! What is this awful stench?! Is it 
raw garbage?!
Spooky... spooky... ghost...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"A-A vegetable monster!? Give me a break, 
don't go haunting me as veggies!"

text_block_list.name: Expired Carrot
text_block_list.text:
I am a rotten carrot past its prime... 
Forgotten by you in the back of the 
fridge...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
D-Darn it...! All because I was being so 
careless...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sooooo sooorrrryyyyyy!!!!! I'll never 
forget again, so please forgive meee!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A-A dream, huh...? Broke out into a weird 
cold sweat...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having suffered a nightmare, Hishi Amazon 
was unable to get a proper rest...
